caption: Windmills, Mykonos
composition: Kato Mili windmills above Little Venice · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Looking northwest, the white Kato Mili windmills with dark thatched caps and wooden sails stand on the ridge above Little Venice. Balconies hang over the water, and the Aegean is in the foreground. The night is mainly clear with about a third cloud cover, about 19.4°C, and a breeze near 17 km/h. Waterfront lamps and moonlight light the mills; they are not under a spotlight rig.
